home.intro: Open a domino table, share the code, and play with your friends while you talk.

profile.title: Profile

play.createHint: You're the boss: you choose the rules.
play.joinHint: Enter the 4-letter code a friend sent you.

error.seat_taken: Someone just took that seat. Try again.
error.rate_limited: You opened a lot of tables. Wait a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

domino.waitingHint: The game starts as soon as every seat is taken.
domino.shareText: Come play domino with me on ICOSIUM! Table code: {code}

error.conflict: The table moved on. Try again.
error.not_seated: You are not seated at this table.

domino.consultUs: Your team opens: talk it over
domino.consultThem: The other team is deciding who opens
domino.fillBotsHint: Free seats go to bots and the game starts.

domino.declareMine: You were dealt 6 tiles of the {n} family.

domino.declareExplain: Redeal: shuffle and deal again. Keep: play on, but the keeping team scores nothing this round, the points go to the opponents.
domino.roundReplay: Nobody scores: the round is replayed and the double-six opens.
domino.penalized: Hand kept: the points go to the other team.
domino.rotateHint: Turn your phone sideways for more room
